integrity: The new contribution is the central-symmetry/two-radius theorem and the resulting odd-m global rigidity. The proof is analytic; literature comparisons distinguish global rigidity from local infinitesimal flexibility and from the distinct (4k,k) family.
limitations: The flexible even-m existence half is quoted from prior work; no classification of all flexible even-m examples is claimed. The theorem assumes strict convexity and does not address degenerate convex polygons with collinear consecutive edges.
title: Parity classification at the half-minus-one bicycle diagonal
